13408988.context: A particle has velocity $v(t)=4\csc^2 t$, measured in meters per second. Use this function for the first four parts. The second particle is introduced in part 5.

13498401.context: A bakery models its weekly profit in dollars by $p(x)=ax^2+bx$, where $x$ is the number of cakes sold in a week and $a$ and $b$ are constants. Use the information in the following parts to determine the coefficients and investigate the profit.
13498401.basis: Part 1 solution supplies the polynomial definition; part 2 supplies the bakery, cakes, dollars and weekly units.
